body: Are you sure you are not reusing the $query variable?
What is wrong with the SQL you pasted in the ticket description? It looks like valid SQL. What SQL gets generated from your 'clean' function?

the last line

``` sql
ON (Products.id = (TagsProducts.product_id) AND Products.id = (TagsProducts.product_id))
```

should be

``` sql
ON (Products.id = (TagsProducts.product_id) AND Tags.id = (TagsProducts.tag_id))
```
Ok, I would hazard that some state is accidentally being preserved in the associations.

I'm 98% sure this is a problem in `BelongsToMany::junction()`

@harpax can you share the code for the 2 table objects you have? If you also have a TagsProductsTable class please share it as well
@harpax Could you create that class? Make it have the two belongsTo. One for Products and one for Tags. I will try to reproduce your issue meanwhile
Thanks for all the info. I will look into the issue
Closing as there is a pull request open to fix this issue
